第007章：张德华元婴五重
华纪55年7月1日，华夏基地，地下修炼室。
修炼室位于基地地下三百米深处，四周由三层灵能合金装甲包裹，内部刻满了从上古仙府中破解出的隔灵阵法。这是华夏联盟专门为张德华修建的突破专用场所，能够承受元婴境突破时产生的灵气暴动。此刻，张德华盘膝坐在修炼室中央的聚灵阵上，面前悬浮着一枚鸽卵大小的丹药。
那丹药通体赤金，表面有细密的纹路流转，像活物一般在缓缓呼吸。丹药内部隐隐有雷鸣之声传出，每一次“呼吸”都带动着整间修炼室的灵气随之脉动——这就是从上古仙府第三层丹药库中取出的“破境丹”，上古仙尊亲手炼制，专供元婴境修士突破小境界所用。整个仙府也只找到了三枚，每一枚都价值连城。
张德华已经卡在元婴四重巅峰三个月了。三个月来，他尝试了各种方法——灵气灌顶、基因优化、功法参悟——但元婴四重到五重的那层瓶颈像一堵无形的墙，怎么都撞不穿。这不是天赋的问题，而是时间的问题。他突破元婴四重才不到半年，根基虽然扎实，但积累远远不够。正常修士从元婴四重到五重，少则十年，多则百年。
但张德华等不了十年。远征天狼星系的计划已经提上日程，他必须在出发前将修为提升到至少元婴六重，才能在面对天罡宗炼虚境老祖时有一战之力。所以他选择了最快也最危险的方式——服用破境丹。
“系统，分析破境丹药力。”
“分析中。”系统的声音在脑海中响起，“破境丹，上古仙尊炼制，品阶——天级上品。药力构成：千年灵药精华百分之四十三、龙髓百分之十二、凤血百分之八、其余为未知上古灵材。服用后突破成功率：百分之九十七。副作用：经脉轻微损伤，七日可愈。”
百分之九十七。张德华点了点头，将破境丹送入口中。
丹药入腹的瞬间，他感觉像吞下了一颗太阳。
炽热的药力从丹田爆发，如火山喷发般涌向四肢百骸。他的经脉在药力的冲击下剧烈膨胀，原本只有筷子粗的经脉被撑到了手指粗细，经脉壁上的裂纹以肉眼可见的速度被药力修复，然后再次被撑裂，再修复……每一次循环，经脉都变得更加坚韧、更加宽阔。
丹田之中，元婴睁开了眼睛。
那是一个缩小版的张德华，通体金光，盘坐在丹田中央。元婴的身高原本只有三寸，此刻在药力的催动下正在以肉眼可见的速度增长——三寸一分、三寸二分、三寸五分、四寸……每增长一分，张德华的气息就攀升一截。
修炼室内的灵气被张德华的身体疯狂吸入，形成了一个肉眼可见的灵气漩涡。漩涡的中心是张德华，边缘则扩散到了整间修炼室，将墙壁上的隔灵阵法冲击得嗡嗡作响。
“灵气浓度突破上限！建议启动备用聚灵阵！”AI“伏羲”的声音在修炼室中响起。
“启动。”张德华咬牙道。
备用聚灵阵启动，四面墙壁上的符文同时亮起，将基地外部的灵气疯狂抽入修炼室。灵气的浓度继续攀升，很快达到了正常值的五十倍。在这样的浓度下，普通人连呼吸都困难，但张德华的每一个毛孔都在贪婪地吸收着灵气，将它们转化为自身的法力。
元婴在继续长大。
四寸五分、四寸八分、五寸……当元婴长到五寸时，张德华感觉体内有什么东西裂开了。不是痛，而是一种束缚被打破后的轻松——像一只被困在茧中的蝴蝶终于破茧而出，像一条被冰封的河流终于解冻奔涌。
元婴五重，突破。

元婴的增长停止了，最终定格在五寸二分。新生的元婴比之前更加凝实，金光更加纯粹，五官也清晰了许多。元婴的双眼缓缓睁开，看向张德华，仿佛在说——你做到了。
张德华缓缓吐出一口浊气，那口气在空中凝而不散，足足维持了十息才消散。他感觉自己的身体发生了质变——力量、速度、反应、神识，全部提升了一个档次。更可怕的是，他对灵气的感知变得更加敏锐，方圆百里的灵气流动尽收眼底，每一缕灵气的走向都清晰可见。
“系统，战力评估。”
“评估中。宿主当前修为：元婴五重。肉身强度：堪比元婴巅峰。法力总量：元婴五重标准值的十倍。神识覆盖范围：五百里。综合战力评估——可越阶战斗，与炼虚初期修士有一战之力。”
炼虚初期。
张德华的嘴角微微上扬。化神之上是炼虚，他一个元婴五重，战力已经摸到了炼虚的门槛。这意味着就算面对天罡宗的星河老祖，他也不是毫无还手之力。
“战力堪比炼虚初期，但修为还是元婴五重。”他自言自语，“距离化神还有五重。元婴六、七、八、九、巅峰，然后才能冲击化神。”
五重。说多不多，说少不少。正常修士从元婴五重到化神，少则数百年，多则上千年。但张德华不是正常修士——他有上古仙府的资源，有华夏联盟的科技辅助，有系统的精确指导。他有信心在一年内突破化神。
他站起身，活动了一下筋骨。骨骼发出一阵噼里啪啦的脆响，像放鞭炮一样。右臂上之前在突破时被药力冲击出的淤青正在迅速消退，皮肤下隐隐有金光流转。
“首长。”门外传来陈铁军的声音，“突破成功了？”
张德华推开修炼室的合金门，走了出去。陈铁军站在门外，身后是一群焦急等待的参谋和医生。看到张德华走出来，所有人都松了一口气。
“突破了。”张德华说，“元婴五重。”
“太好了！”陈铁军激动得握紧了拳头，“这下远征的把握更大了！”
张德华点了点头，但没有多说什么。他沿着走廊向地面走去，身后的人自动让开一条路。走到电梯口时，他忽然停下脚步。
“陈将军。”
“在。”
“传令下去，三天后，远征军进行最后一次实战演练。演练结束后，确定出发时间。”
“是！”
张德华走进电梯，门缓缓合上。电梯向地面上升的过程中，他透过透明的电梯壁看到了基地外面的景象——训练场上，太空陆战队员正在进行零重力环境下的战术演练；机库里，凌霄战机正在进行最后一次检修；指挥中心的大屏幕上，天狼星系的星图正在缓缓旋转。
一切都在按计划进行。

Chapter 007: Zhang Dehua Nascent Soul Fifth Level
July 1, 55 Years of Chinese Era, underground training room at Huaxia Base.
The training room is located 300 meters deep underground in the base. It is surrounded by three layers of psychic alloy armor, and the interior is engraved with spirit isolation formations cracked from ancient immortal mansions. This is a breakthrough place specially built by the Chinese Alliance for Zhang Dehua. It can withstand the spiritual energy riot generated when the Nascent Soul realm breaks through. At this moment, Zhang Dehua was sitting cross-legged on the spirit gathering array in the center of the training room, with a pill the size of a pigeon egg suspended in front of him.
The elixir was completely red gold, with fine lines flowing on its surface, breathing slowly like a living creature. There was a faint sound of thunder inside the elixir, and every "breath" caused the spiritual energy in the entire practice room to pulsate - this was the "Breaking Realm Pill" taken from the third-floor elixir storehouse of the Ancient Immortal Mansion. It was personally refined by the Ancient Immortal Lord and specially used by Nascent Soul Realm monks to break through small realms. Only three were found in the entire Immortal Mansion, and each one was priceless.
Zhang Dehua has been stuck at the fourth level of Nascent Soul for three months. In the past three months, he had tried various methods—spiritual energy initiation, genetic optimization, and skill comprehension—but the bottleneck between the fourth and fifth levels of Nascent Soul was like an invisible wall that he could not break through no matter what. It's not a matter of talent, it's a matter of time. It had only been less than half a year since he broke through to the fourth level of Nascent Soul. Although his foundation was solid, his accumulation was far from enough. Normal monks go from the fourth level to the fifth level of Nascent Soul, which takes as little as ten years and as many as a hundred years.
But Zhang Dehua cannot wait ten years. The plan to expedition to the Sirius Galaxy has been put on the agenda. He must upgrade his cultivation to at least the sixth level of Nascent Soul before departure in order to be able to fight against the ancestor of the Tiangang Sect's Void Refining Realm. So he chose the fastest and most dangerous way - taking the Realm Breaking Pill.
"System, analyze the power of the realm-breaking elixir."
"Under analysis." The voice of the system rang in his mind, "Breaking Realm Pill, refined by the ancient Immortal Lord, grade - heaven-level top grade. The composition of the medicine: 43% of the essence of the thousand-year elixir, 12% of the dragon marrow, 8% of the phoenix blood, and the rest is unknown ancient spiritual materials. The breakthrough success rate after taking it: 97%. Side effects: slight damage to the meridians, which can be healed in seven days."
Ninety-seven percent. Zhang Dehua nodded and put the Breaking Realm Pill into his mouth.
The moment the elixir entered his stomach, he felt as if he had swallowed a sun.
The fiery medicinal power erupts from the Dantian and rushes to the limbs and bones like a volcanic eruption. His meridians swelled violently under the impact of the medicine. The meridians that were originally only as thick as chopsticks were stretched to the thickness of a finger. The cracks on the walls of the meridians were repaired by the medicine at a speed visible to the naked eye, and then were stretched again, and then repaired... With each cycle, the meridians became tougher and wider.
In the dantian, Yuanying opened his eyes.
It was a miniature version of Zhang Dehua, covered in golden light, sitting cross-legged in the middle of his dantian. Nascent Soul's height was originally only three inches, but now under the influence of the medicine, it was growing at a speed visible to the naked eye - three inches to one point, three inches to two points, three inches to five points, four inches... With every increase, Zhang Dehua's aura increased.
The spiritual energy in the training room was crazily inhaled by Zhang Dehua's body, forming a spiritual energy vortex visible to the naked eye. The center of the vortex was Zhang Dehua, and the edges spread to the entire training room, making the spirit isolation formation on the wall buzz.
"The spiritual energy concentration has exceeded the upper limit! It is recommended to activate the backup spirit gathering array!" The voice of AI "Fuxi" sounded in the training room.
"Start." Zhang Dehua gritted his teeth and said.
The backup spirit gathering array was activated, and the runes on the four walls lit up at the same time, drawing the spiritual energy from outside the base into the training room. The concentration of spiritual energy continued to rise, and soon reached fifty times the normal value. At such a concentration, it would be difficult for ordinary people to even breathe, but every pore of Zhang Dehua's body was greedily absorbing the spiritual energy and converting it into his own magic power.
Nascent Soul continues to grow.
Four inches and five inches, four inches and eight points, five inches...When the Nascent Soul grew to five inches, Zhang Dehua felt something crack inside his body. It's not pain, but a kind of relief after the constraints are broken - like a butterfly trapped in a cocoon finally breaking out of the cocoon, like a frozen river finally thawing and flowing.
Nascent Soul fifth level, breakthrough.
The growth of Nascent Soul stopped, and finally settled at five inches and two minutes. The newborn Nascent Soul is more solid than before, the golden light is purer, and the facial features are much clearer. Yuanying's eyes slowly opened and looked at Zhang Dehua, as if to say - you did it.
Zhang Dehua slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, which lingered in the air for ten breaths before dissipating. He felt that his body had undergone a qualitative change - his strength, speed, reaction, and consciousness had all been upgraded to a higher level. What's even more frightening is that his perception of spiritual energy has become more acute. He can see the flow of spiritual energy within a hundred miles, and the direction of every ray of spiritual energy is clearly visible.
"System, combat power assessment."
"Under evaluation. The host's current cultivation level: the fifth level of Nascent Soul. Physical strength: comparable to the peak of the Nascent Soul. Total mana: ten times the standard value of the fifth level of the Nascent Soul. Divine consciousness coverage: 500 miles. Comprehensive combat power assessment - can fight across levels, and can compete with monks in the early stage of virtual refining."
The early stage of virtual refining.
The corners of Zhang Dehua's mouth raised slightly. Above the Transformation God is Lianxu. He is at the fifth level of Nascent Soul, and his combat power has reached the threshold of Lianxu. This means that even if he faces the Galaxy Patriarch of the Tiangang Sect, he is not without the power to fight back.
"The combat power is comparable to that of the early stage of refining the void, but the cultivation level is still at the fifth level of Nascent Soul." He said to himself, "There are still five levels before becoming a god. Nascent Soul will be at the sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, and peak level, and then you can hit the god transformation."
Fivefold. Say too much but not too much, say too little too much. It can take anywhere from hundreds to thousands of years for a normal monk to go from the fifth level of the Nascent Soul to the Transformation of God. But Zhang Dehua is not a normal monk - he has the resources of the ancient immortal mansion, the technological assistance of the Chinese Alliance, and systematic and precise guidance. He is confident that he will achieve a breakthrough in becoming a god within a year.
He stood up and stretched his muscles. The bones made a crackling sound, like firecrackers. The bruises on his right arm that were hit by the medicine during the breakthrough are quickly fading, and there is a faint golden light flowing under the skin.
"Chief." Chen Tiejun's voice came from outside the door, "Did the breakthrough succeed?"
Zhang Dehua pushed open the alloy door of the training room and walked out. Chen Tiejun stood outside the door, followed by a group of anxiously waiting staff officers and doctors. Seeing Zhang Dehua come out, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
"Breakthrough." Zhang Dehua said, "Fifth level of Nascent Soul."
"Great!" Chen Tiejun clenched his fists in excitement, "Now we have greater confidence in the expedition!"
Zhang Dehua nodded, but said nothing more. He walked along the corridor toward the ground, and the people behind him automatically moved out of the way. When he reached the elevator, he suddenly stopped.
"General Chen."
"Here."
"The order is passed. In three days, the expeditionary force will conduct its last actual combat drill. After the drill, the departure time will be determined."
"Yes!"
Zhang Dehua walked into the elevator and the door slowly closed. As the elevator ascended to the ground, he saw the scene outside the base through the transparent elevator wall - on the training ground, the space marines were conducting tactical exercises in a zero-gravity environment; in the hangar, the Lingxiao fighter was undergoing its final overhaul; on the large screen in the command center, the star map of the Sirius galaxy was slowly rotating.
Everything is going according to plan.
